g.text: HPS magnetic transport through the active silicon tracker
Examples pass the run-dependent hit cuts at the first and last nonzero sampled masses; they do not define exact endpoints.
Pinned 3D field maps; transverse display scales expanded. 15 mrad labels use equal sharing, x = 1 and negligible electron mass.
